lines.t: Walk uprightly in Me, in My very footsteps, (ooh)
Abide in the doctrine given and true.
Hold fast to the faith you’ve received within, (ah)
And the knowledge I’ve written in you. (ooh)
Progress toward perfection, with all trust in My Word, (ooh)
Keep the commandments as light to be heard. (ah)
Testify by the life that you live,
Turn from the world, let your spirit give. (ooh)
No more walk in the ways of this world, (ah)
For its shadows will vanish away. (ooh)
Stand in the peace I have poured within, (ah)
Let My truth be your strength each day. (ooh)
Progress toward perfection, with all trust in My Word, (ooh)
Keep the commandments as light to be heard. (ah)
Testify by the life that you live, (ooh)
Turn from the world, let your spirit give. (ah)
In patience endure, in mercy remain, (ooh)
For My footsteps are paths through the rain. (ah)
Rise up in faith, let your voice proclaim, (ooh)
Love unending, forever My name. (ah)
Progress toward perfection, with all trust in My Word, (ooh)
Keep the commandments as light to be heard. (ah)
Walk uprightly in Me, as you testify true, (ooh)
For I am the life abiding in you. (ah)
Ooh… ah… (ooh)
Walk uprightly in Me, in My very footsteps (ah)
